seo.title: Transcription MCP & YouTube Transcript MCP for ChatGPT and Claude | TranscriptX
seo.description: Add the TranscriptX transcription MCP to ChatGPT as a custom MCP server or to Claude as a custom connector. Paste a YouTube link or attach a file and get the transcript in the chat.
seo.schemaDescription: Transcription MCP connector for ChatGPT and Claude. Turns links and audio or video files into text that the AI assistant can summarize, translate or answer questions about.
seo.ogTitle: Transcription MCP for ChatGPT and Claude — TranscriptX
seo.ogDescription: Add TranscriptX once. Paste a link or attach a file, and your AI assistant gets the transcript.

hero.h1: Transcription MCP – Transcribe Right Inside ChatGPT and Claude
hero.subtitle: Add TranscriptX once. Then paste a YouTube or podcast link, or attach a file — your AI assistant gets the transcript to summarize, translate or ask about.

preview.label: Preview
preview.content: The official TranscriptX app is under review by ChatGPT and Claude. Until it is listed, add it yourself with the link below.

setup.h2: Add to ChatGPT as a Custom MCP Server
steps: Click the button — ChatGPT opens on Plugins and the link is copied.
Click + › Add custom MCP server, paste the link, tick “I understand”, then Create.
Sign in with Google, or try it without an account.
setup.note: Don't see “Add custom MCP server”? Turn on Settings › Security › Developer mode.

setup.h2: Add to Claude as a Custom Connector
steps: Click the button — Claude opens Settings › Connectors and the link is copied.
Click Add custom connector and paste the link.
Click Connect, then sign in with Google, or try it without an account.

list: YouTube links — use it as a YouTube transcript MCP in ChatGPT or Claude.
Links from TikTok, Instagram, X, podcasts and direct media URLs.
Shared Google Drive, Dropbox and OneDrive links.
Audio and video files — attached in ChatGPT, or uploaded from your device in Claude.
sections.note: The result card shows the start of the transcript with Copy, Export (TXT, SRT, VTT) and a link to the full transcript.

items.content: Transcribe an audio or video file — attached in the chat (ChatGPT) or sent through an upload box (Claude).
Read a finished transcript, in parts for long recordings. Read-only.

content: Free daily allowance for guests and free accounts; [TranscriptX Pro](/pricing) lifts most limits. Nothing is purchased inside the chat. Very long media may exceed your plan, and private or removed links cannot be transcribed.
TranscriptX only receives the link or file you ask it to transcribe. Uploaded files are deleted within 12 hours. Disconnect anytime from ChatGPT or Claude settings. [Privacy Policy](/privacy-policy/)

items.a: A connector that lets ChatGPT or Claude turn speech into text, so you can transcribe links and files right in the chat.

items.q: Does it work as a YouTube transcript MCP?
items.a: Yes. Paste any public YouTube link and ask ChatGPT or Claude to transcribe it.
Yes, there is a free daily allowance, and you can try it without an account.
No. It only receives the link or file you ask it to transcribe.
